project_type: Greenfield React SPA (Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind) with Supabase Cloud backend (Postgres + Auth + RLS). SQL authored as plain .sql files for manual paste into the Supabase SQL editor; no local Supabase/Docker.
build_system: Vite 5+ with @vitejs/plugin-react; pnpm ONLY (version 10.17.0 installed). Node 20.19.2.
test_framework: None. No live Supabase project, so end-to-end runtime testing is OUT OF SCOPE.
test_command: pnpm run build (type-check via tsc + vite build is the test bar)
verification_instructions: 1) pnpm install succeeds and writes pnpm-lock.yaml. 2) pnpm run build compiles with ZERO TypeScript errors. 3) grep confirms the SQL object names used by the frontend (public_tickets, reserve_ticket, admin_emails, tickets) all exist in supabase/*.sql. 4) status literals (available|reserved|paid) and sold_by literals (Felipe|Pipe) are consistent across src/types.ts, src/config.ts, and supabase/*.sql. 5) No hardcoded user-facing strings outside i18n locale files. 6) Public-facing code never queries the base tickets table (only public_tickets view + reserve_ticket RPC).
snapshot_or_generated_files: pnpm-lock.yaml is generated by pnpm install and MUST be committed. dist/ is build output and is gitignored. No other generated-then-committed files.
environment_constraints: Docker is NOT running; do NOT run 'supabase start' or any local Supabase. Cloud-only: SQL files are pasted by the user later. The workspace path contains a literal space: '/Users/leandroovalle/Visual Studio Code/Personal /Rifa' — ALWAYS quote it in shell commands. git is NOT initialized yet. No git remote; do NOT push.
contribution_requirements: pnpm only (package.json must declare "packageManager": "pnpm@10.17.0"; .npmrc has engine-strict=true). .gitignore ignores node_modules, dist, .env/.env.local, package-lock.json, yarn.lock; keeps .env.example and pnpm-lock.yaml. Initial commit on a DEV branch, Spanish commit message 'v0.1.0 Init: estructura inicial de la app de rifa'. All user-facing text via react-i18next keys (es primary, en fallback). Do NOT push, do NOT configure deploy credentials.
key_patterns: Tailwind v3 with tailwind.config.js (darkMode:'class', theme.extend.colors.brand amber scale, fontFamily.sans Inter+system-ui) + postcss.config.js + @tailwind directives. Supabase JS v2 createClient(url, anonKey). Google auth via supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({provider:'google'}); session via onAuthStateChange + getSession; admin email from session.user.email. Public reads ONLY via public_tickets view; public writes ONLY via reserve_ticket SECURITY DEFINER RPC. Admin reads/writes base tickets table gated by RLS (auth.jwt()->>'email' in admin_emails).
directory_structure: Root: config files (package.json, vite.config.ts, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, tsconfig*.json, .npmrc, .env.example, .gitignore, index.html, README.md). src/: main.tsx, App.tsx, config.ts, types.ts, index.css; src/lib/ (supabase.ts, csv.ts); src/i18n/ (index.ts, locales/es.json, locales/en.json); src/hooks/ (useAuth.ts); src/components/ (shared + public + admin components); src/pages/ (PublicView.tsx, AdminView.tsx). supabase/: ordered .sql files (01_schema, 02_views, 03_rls, 04_functions, 05_seed). .agents/tasks/: planning artifacts (NOT part of the app, excluded from app concerns).
